cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault; first funding may use wallet-signed CreateAccount or a native Payment to avoid public-account precreation griefing. Connected-wallet support for both remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Direct endpoint probes could not run under the local DNS sandbox. Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; open design, implementation, and release work remains. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target; provider selection remains unresolved and source helpers have no provider wiring. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commit 3ff9f64e changes `fetch_latest_reserve_observations` to apply full latest-ledger quorum and return agreed `LatestLedgerReserve` data (sequence, `closed_at`, and conservative reserve) instead of a value-only amount. No callers exist yet. Commits bdb7d742 and 54c175cf add optional operation identity preservation and bounded fixed-slot provider fetches. Scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed; no Cargo tests or live outcalls have run. This source path does not establish provider independence or live freshness; there is no credit/admission lifecycle.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: Commit 3ff9f64e exposes the full agreed latest-ledger reserve record from the fetch helper; it has no callers and remains uncompiled. Commits bdb7d742 and 54c175cf add deterministic operation identity and bounded provider observations, also without Cargo or live-call verification. Credit/key/receipt/status state remains dormant; no deposit or claim mutation is integrated. Generated Candid and frontend declarations remain stale after the key setter change. Config remains Frozen; XLM is not registered, deployed, or admitted as collateral.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Commit 3ff9f64e routes latest-reserve fetch through full observation quorum and returns sequence, `closed_at`, and conservative reserve, but no callers use it. This is not live reserve proof. No Cargo tests or live outcalls have run (shared heavy hold; about 16 GiB free, roughly 1%). There is still no deposit/borrow endpoint, atomic credit mutation, or admission. WP3 remains blocked; provider independence, live freshness/oracle, and testnet/frontend integration remain open. No live provider/oracle proof, XLM admission, or deployment is proved.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: Commit 8dd604c7 adds pure fixed-slot transaction-status provider classification and a dormant fetch-to-quorum wrapper; `transaction_status.rs` also has documentation corrections. Rustfmt/diff checks passed, but no Cargo tests/build or live calls were run. This wrapper does not implement claim settlement or payout; the policy's 39 tests remain unrun. Commit 465f1082's claim recorder remains unwired. Provider independence and evidence freshness remain unresolved, so WP4 stays blocked. The XRP post-sign status race is a separate reuse caution, not an XLM-specific required gate. Reserve/oracle checks, testnet, frontend, and release remain open. Frozen config prevents XLM admission.

cards.scope: Integrate Candid, user flows, and operator monitoring
cards.evidenceText: Earlier Candid regeneration and compatibility checks passed. Source-only key setter/getter changes the Candid interface; generated `.did` and frontend declarations remain stale pending canonical regeneration. Multi-operation receipt/status and frontend guard changes have not been compiled. Full XLM frontend integration and supported deposit/withdrawal/claim flows remain open.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: Earlier focused `chains::stellar` Cargo tests passed 34/34 before these changes. Commit 8dd604c7 adds a dormant fetch-to-quorum transaction-status wrapper and pure fixed-slot classification; it remains uncompiled/unrun with no live calls. Commit 465f1082's claim recorder remains unwired. Provider independence, live freshness, credit, and settlement remain unproved. WP3/WP4/release remain blocked; no live proof, admission, or deployment.

cards.scope: Prepare deployment, configuration, and activation evidence
cards.evidenceText: Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; a separate transaction-status review file is underway. A provider network-binding agent is also working. Broader release work remains open: current reserve freshness/oracle validation, deposit and claim lifecycles, testnet/frontend integration, exact-head validation, artifact review, and rollback/monitoring. Release is blocked. The live XRP post-sign status race remains a separate XRP reuse caution, not a required XLM gate. No live provider/oracle proof, deployment, or activation is proved.
